summary: Georgia lookout-list entry 'daniel' (GA094, GFC 134) in Bryan County, about 31.9N 81.4W; the name is a list label. No source found describes its build, staffing, fate or site today.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. The only tower-specific source is the GA tower list. Two WebSearches (Daniel Bryan County GFC; Bryan County historic tower) and the Bryan County 2018 wildfire protection plan (gatrees.org; lists GFC units at Ellabell and Midway and does not name a lookout in the lines matched) turned up nothing about a Daniel tower. Search results showed Richmond Hill antenna-registry entries; not read and not used. Proposed correction: registers 'GFC US 134' to 'GFC 134' (see corrections). The list gives elevation (14) with no unit stated, so it is not used. Brief status, access and visit values are unsupported, so no facts keys are written. Next step if wanted: ask the GFC or Bryan County whether a tower stood near 31.908, -81.360 and whether it was removed.
